steps.description:
The image below shows how you can form the condition that checks whether an obstacle falls within 20cm to 40cm away from the Ultrasonic Sensor ("within" means include 20cm and 40cm).




Using the blocks below, create a code for a Soap Dispenser. If the user places his or her hand within 10cm to 15cm beneath the dispenser, liquid soap will be dispensed. You may need to change some values in the blocks.

You are creating a program to detect parcels moving along a conveyor belt. 
The smallest parcel is 20cm high and the biggest parcel is 30cm high. 
Study the diagram and code below and complete the condition.
